name: CAMUS_unseen_LV_support_and_adaptation_pilot_v1
dataset: CAMUS_public NIfTI rerelease, manual ED/ES frames, verified MedOtter parquet conversion
source_checkpoint_selection: existing source-domain validation-selected checkpoint; no target test selection
support_sampling: sample 16 official training patients without replacement; first 4 form nested K=4; one 4CH ED frame per selected patient
label_budget: exactly K images from K patients used for support and adaptation; no extra target validation labels for selection
test: all 50 official test patients, both 2CH/4CH views and ED/ES manual frames; 200 frames
validation: official validation split excluded; not used to select adaptation settings
paper_US_adapter: strict load original model; new task text; unseen-domain identity residual disabled; group residual retained; source text-centering direction fixed
paper_US_skip_rule: if original frozen BioBERT encoder assets are unavailable, record unsupported method without inventing text vectors
no_weight_update: F/Iris/paper adapter use K labelled target supports; plain baselines receive no target supports and are descriptive target-free references

adaptation.support_images_per_microstep: up to 4 of the K labelled images, excluding the one query image
adaptation.loss: one CE plus one foreground soft Dice; no model-specific auxiliary losses
adaptation.checkpoint_selection: last update only, no target validation/test selection
adaptation.augmentation: existing generic medical augmentation; matched query seed across architectures

normalization: original per-image z-score, clamp +/-5, divide by 5
primary_aggregation: mean of four manual frame metrics within patient, then mean of 50 patients
pretraining_caveat: medical foundation-model exposure to CAMUS must be audited before clean unseen-organ claims; SAM-Med2D not in primary controlled table
reporting: report every predefined method/regime/K/support draw, including failures; no test-based hyperparameter search
